## Checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/build.mjs --check` prints `0 errors`
- [ ] `node --test` passes
- [ ] Every date I added or changed has a source listed on the entry
- [ ] I did not change the `id` of an existing entry or view
- [ ] Screenshots are included, or nothing on the page changes
- [ ] If I changed the page, the browser console is clean at 1440 and 390 px
- [ ] An AI assistant helped with this change, and I checked its facts against the sources (tick only if it applies)
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed as described in `LICENSE` (MIT for code, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for content)
